title: Official: Espanyol star suffers ACL tear in training
snippet: La Liga outfit Espanyol have this week announced an altogether considerable setback on the personnel front in the club’s first-team ranks. This comes by way of confirmation that Álex Calatrava…
body: La Liga outfit Espanyol have this week announced an altogether considerable setback on the personnel front in the club’s first-team ranks. This comes by way of confirmation that Álex Calatrava is set for a long-term incoming spell on the sidelines. Attacker Calatrava, better known as ‘Cala’, has played a prominent role in the colours of Espanyol across the season to date, featuring in all but one of the club’s La Liga fixtures. Along the way, amid what has been an underwhelming campaign all told for the Pericos, the 26-year-old has chipped in with a solitary goal. Safe to say, then, that the latest news stemming from the club’s training ground will come as a blow for all of an Espanyol persuasion… As per a statement across the website and social media platforms of the Barcelona-based club on Wednesday: ‘Àlex Calatrava has torn the anterior cruciate ligament in his left knee during Wednesday’s training session at CE Dani Jarque.’ 📋 INFORME MÈDIC | Àlex Calatrava El jugador s’ha trencat el lligament encreuat anterior del genoll esquerra durant la sessió d’entrenament d’aquest dimecres a la CE Dani Jarque. Molta força, Cala, estem amb tu! 💙 #RCDE Conor Laird – GSFN
summary_en: Espanyol confirmed attacker Álex Calatrava tore his ACL in training and faces a long absence.

title: Official: Atlético Madrid announce injury setback
snippet: La Liga giants Atlético Madrid have on Tuesday announced a personnel setback in the club’s first-team ranks. This comes amid confirmation that Ademola Lookman is set for an incoming spell on…
body: La Liga giants Atlético Madrid have on Tuesday announced a personnel setback in the club’s first-team ranks. This comes amid confirmation that Ademola Lookman is set for an incoming spell on the sidelines. Attacker Lookman for his part set alarm bells sounding in Spain’s capital this past weekend. After featuring from the off in Nigeria’s AFCON qualifier against Tanzania, the former Atalanta man was hooked from proceedings during the first-half. After pulling up with what appeared to be a knee problem, it was quickly made clear to Lookman by the Nigerian medical team that he was in no fit state to continue. The 29-year-old, from here, returned to base in Madrid, for a round of scans and tests. And as alluded to above, Atlético have since confirmed that Lookman has indeed suffered a knee injury. As per a statement across the website and social media platforms of the Rojiblancos: ‘Ademola Lookman suffered a high-grade knee sprain, which occurred during Nigeria’s match against Tanzania last Friday, November 13. ‘Although the Nigerian national team’s medical staff initially reported that the striker had suffered a minor sprain, the club’s medical team examined the Nigerian footballer upon his return to Madrid, in addition to carrying out further tests, and confirmed the exact extent of his injury. ‘Lookman will undergo physiotherapy sessions and rehabilitation work in the gym, and the evolution of his injury will determine his return to competition.’ Lookman sufre un esguince de
summary_en: Atletico Madrid announced Lookman will be sidelined after a knee problem sustained playing for Nigeria.
